shared_elements: incised linear carving on a flat stone surface
elements arranged in a band or register along the edges
justification: A shows purely abstract content: a border of incised lines with rows of angular script-like signs framing a large empty field with an arc and a cross-like stem, with no figures at all. B shows a crowded naturalistic figural procession of human figures with bows and spears, harnessed horses and a spoked chariot wheel; the only overlap is the generic fact of incised linear designs on stone and a curved arc, which any tradition could produce independently.
